                                  Quill Letter                                  
                                                                                
          Dear reader,                                                          
                                                                                
          This letter has bold, italic, underlined and struck text,             
          plus a coloured word and some raised and lowered text.                
                                                                                
          Item           Qty.................Price                              
          Quills         12...................3.50                              
          Ink bottles    3....................8.25                              
          Paper (500 sheets).....................1     6.75                     
                                                                                
             A justified paragraph with a hanging indent. It is long            
               enough to run over several lines, so the line breaks             
               and the spacing between the words can be checked on              
               every platform that shows it, in a typewriter font as            
               well as ▒curly quotes▒ and an em dash▒here.                      
                                                                                
                                                          Yours truly,          
                                                        The Quill team

                                  Quill Letter                                  
                                                                                
          Dear reader,                                                          
                                                                                
          This letter has bold, italic, underlined and struck text,             
          plus a coloured word and some raised and lowered text.                
                                                                                
          Item           Qty.................Price                              
          Quills         12...................3.50                              
          Ink bottles    3....................8.25                              
          Paper (500 sheets).....................1     6.75                     
                                                                                
             A justified paragraph with a hanging indent. It is long            
               enough to run over several lines, so the line breaks             
               and the spacing between the words can be checked on              
               every platform that shows it, in a typewriter font as            
               well as ▒curly quotes▒ and an em dash▒here.                      
                                                                                
                                                          Yours truly,          
                                                        The Quill team

          Dear reader,                                                          
                                                                                
          This letter has bold, italic, underlined and struck text,             
          plus a coloured word and some raised and lowered text.                
                                                                                
          Item           Qty.................Price                              
          Quills         12...................3.50                              
          Ink bottles    3....................8.25                              
          Paper (500 sheets).....................1     6.75                     
                                                                                
             A justified paragraph with a hanging indent. It is long            
               enough to run over several lines, so the line breaks             
               and the spacing between the words can be checked on              
               every platform that shows it, in a typewriter font as            
               well as ▒curly quotes▒ and an em dash▒here.
